title: Summarize a configuration profile
hints: plistlib.loads(data) turns the bytes into a dict; PayloadContent is a list of dicts inside it.
Use dict.get(key, default) for every optional key; for the display name the default is the payload's own PayloadType.
sorted({p["type"] for p in payloads}) gives the distinct types in order.
Wrap plistlib.loads in try/except (plistlib.InvalidFileException, ExpatError) as e: raise ValueError(...) from e.
